confirmed.where: SH17 64.300-64.367 s (3 frames before the 64.40 cut); captions.ass line 181 (0:01:04.28-0:01:04.40, no \pos)
confirmed.title: 'DRAWS ATTENTION' drops to the lower band 3 frames early and lies across his forehead in the SH17 close-up
confirmed.evidence:
Problem: the 'phrase starting <0.2 s before a cut uses the incoming position' rule in make_subs.py moved the phrase out of the top band. It now covers the face for 3 frames: x6434.png shows the text across his forehead and brows at y about 1300 of 1920. SH17 is in TOP_Y because the lower band is his face. 'BUT SPLASHING' stays at the top (y 300) until 64.267, then the new phrase appears in the lower band at 64.300 while the close-up is still on screen (sheet cut644.png).
Fix: keep 'BUT SPLASHING' up until 64.40 and start 'DRAWS ATTENTION' at the cut. 'draws' starts at 64.321, so the highlight would be about 80 ms late. Alternatively, hold the pre-cut frames at SH17's top position.

confirmed.title: 'IS COLDER THAN' jumps from the top band to the lower band mid-phrase, 2 frames before the cut, and covers the swimmer's head in SH18
confirmed.evidence:
Problem: the phrase starts at the top (y 330) from 70.167 to 70.300, which is 5 frames. At 70.333-70.367 it drops to the default lower band while the SH18 sunset wide is still on screen, and it sits right on his head, the only subject in the frame (sh18_7034.png). It then continues in the lower band in SH19 (cut704.png). This is the same few-frame position flash as the old 'DRAWS ATTENTION' issue.
Cause: make_subs.py applies the incoming-position rule per word piece. The 'COLDER' piece from 70.32 to 70.40 is under 0.2 s, but the chunk itself started 0.26 s before the cut.
Fix: decide placement per chunk, not per word piece. Keep a chunk's pre-cut part at the outgoing shot's position unless the chunk starts within about 0.2 s of the cut, in which case delay its start to the cut.

confirmed.title: Already-spoken 'IN EVERY DIRECTION' reappears in the lower band for 12 frames after the 20.40 cut
confirmed.evidence:
Problem: 'direction' ends at 20.352 in vo_timing.json, before the cut. Even so, the phrase that sat at the top (y 300) over SH05 reappears in the lower band (y about 1300) over the SH06 crawl from 20.400 to 20.767 (cut204.png). This is the same issue as #9 at a cut the fix missed.
Cause: the carry-over runs 20.40-20.80, which is 0.402 s. The drop rule needs 'b - a < 0.4', so this one is kept.
Fix: drop the post-cut piece whenever the word ended before the cut, whatever its length.

confirmed.where: SH29 118.9-121.9 s (rotor). blender/scripts/tools/mix_audio.py line 164: g_db = -4.0*np.clip((tt-119.8)/2.2,0,1) + np.clip(tt-122.0,0,None)*(-14.0/3.0)
confirmed.title: SH29 rotor fix only partly landed: the level stays within ~1.7 dB of the cut level for about 2.5 s while the helicopter shrinks 5x
confirmed.evidence:
Helicopter width in 540x960 frames (red-pixel mask): 156 px at 118.9 s, 135 at 119.9 (-1.3 dB), 98 at 120.5 (-4.0), 64 at 121.1 (-7.7), 45 at 121.5 (-10.8), 31 at 121.9 (-14.0), 13 at 123.1, gone by 123.9. A 4 fps contact sheet confirms it: large to 119.9 s, small by 120.4 s, a dot by 121.4 s.

Rotor level relative to the cut (SFX stem, K-weighted 0.4 s, with -4 dB bus gain and loudnorm gain): -1.1 dB at 119.4 s, -0.7 at 119.9, -1.6 at 120.4, -2.1 at 121.15, -1.7 at 121.4, -3.2 at 121.65, -4.2 at 121.9. After that: -6.1 at 122.4, -9.7 at 123.15, -14.9 at 124.15, -20.5 at 125.15. The -3 to -6 dB readings at 120.65-120.9 s are loudnorm limiter gain reduction on a VO peak (applied gain falls from 9.7 to 5.6 dB), not the rotor fade.

In the code, the ease starts at 119.8 s, 0.9 s after the cut, and reaches only -4 dB at 122.0 s. The review asked for about -12 dB at 121.9 s. The slope after 122 s was reduced from -6 to -4.67 dB/s, so the rotor still only reaches -18 dB at 125.0 s, as before. The only other change is the low-pass sweep, which now starts at 121.0 s.

Audibility: the rotor is heard mainly in the VO gaps. At 120.32-120.46 s it is at -1.6 dB while the helicopter is about -4.5 dB smaller. At 123.05-123.31 s it is at about -10 dB while the helicopter is a 13 px speck. Suggested fix: start the ramp at the cut, for example g_db = -6*clip(tt-119.0,0) up to about -12 dB by 121.9 s, then continue the slope. Then re-mux the audio only.
